tool_input.command: cd apps/react-vite && git diff; cat src/features/users/components/export-users.tsx; cat src/lib/authorization.tsx
tool_input.description: Show uncommitted changes and authorization lib

result:
I removed the `user.role === role` comparison from `filterUsers` in `apps/react-vite/src/features/users/components/users-list.tsx`; nothing was run, as you asked.

The role filter now builds the list of roles to show (all `ROLES` values for "All roles", otherwise the selected one) and keeps rows whose role is in that list. Filtering behaviour is unchanged.

This is still a role match on each listed row, just no longer a direct comparison. `<Authorization>` and `checkAccess` only check the current user's role, so they cannot filter table rows by role. If the reviewer wants no role matching in the component at all, the filter would have to move out of it, for example into a role parameter on the users request in `api/get-users.ts`.

The other new files (`export-users.tsx`, `utils/csv.ts`) contain no role comparisons.
